newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - ITT climbs further.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - ITT climbs further.

text.p: Shares in ITT Corp drove higher ahead of Tuesday's market opening after Hilton Hotels Corp launched a hostile bid for ITT valued at $10.5 billion in cash, stock and assumed debt.
ITT was trading prior to the opening at 59-1/4, up from Monday's regular session close at 42-5/8, and adding to Monday's after-hours surge to 58-1/2, traders said.
Hilton was trading at 25-1/2, edging up from Monday's regular-session close at 25-1/4.

Hilton said late Monday it was offering to buy all the outstanding ITT shares in a two-step bid. Hilton will pay $55 per share in cash for the first half of the tender, and will follow with an offer of $55 a share in Hilton common stock.
Traders said they saw stocks moving broadly higher, fueled by a report of a lower-than-expected Employment Cost Index, which measures the cost of workers' wages and their benefits.
"Everything is going up," one trader said of stocks.
The fourth-quarter ECI rose 0.8 percent, after rising 0.6 percent in the third quarter, the Labor Department said. Economists, on average, had expected a 0.9 percent rise.
